beats.text: Those tests ask who can appeal, who bears costs, and who can challenge the rules.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: An adult needs a practical path beyond local authority when that authority becomes the problem.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: This is no promise that better phrasing will solve coercion.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Begin with the Bridge Method, then compare its promises with Capture by Pluralism.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Read it to connect truthful disagreement with power that remains answerable when your side wins.
